differences_from_upstream: Native AVBD with nominal BAM and foot-ground contact only; no self-collision or physical domain randomization
Five equally sampled commands: four target directions and standing; neutral head/body commands

All original instantaneous reward equations retain upstream variances; add a 0.5 s world-frame velocity EMA, expose its local-frame state to critic, and reward mean horizontal command tracking (variance 0.0025, weight 4)
Small explicit initial pose perturbations; fixed 20 ms actuator and joint-velocity observation delay, no sensor noise
Actor weights and normalization transferred, new critic and optimizer; lower learning rate, entropy coefficient, and initial action standard deviation 0.05 rad
Native contact timing/force and finite-iteration dynamics are not full upstream parity
FP32 training candidate; independent CPU FP64 rollout and full-asset collision/video audit required
Hold initial heading through a velocity-command controller: yaw command = clamp(0.5 * wrapped heading error, -1, 1); no direct pose or force edits
Add exp(-wrapped_heading_error^2/0.04) with weight 2; expose heading error to critic (80 dimensions), retain actor interface and physical actuation
Initialize from official checkpoint 3500 after its native command-feedback diagnostic demonstrated substantially better heading control than checkpoint 500
